notes: Scope: all nine required items are covered. Dependency order is a clean DAG with no cycles or forward references: ch-01 is the sole root; ch-02/ch-03 depend only on the ledger; ch-04 correctly hangs attention off activations (ch-03); ch-05->ch-06 is a linear kernel progression; ch-07 depends only on ch-01 (does not spuriously require the attention chain); ch-08 pulls ledger+precision+activations+parallelism; ch-09 depends on all prior. Topologically sound.

Cross-link watch, not a blocker: context-parallel appears in BOTH ch-06 (Ring attention as the kernel mechanism) and ch-07 (CP as a parallelism primitive in the world_size accounting). This is the correct two-altitude split, but the author should wikilink the two so ch-07 references ch-06's kernel math rather than re-deriving it, to prevent duplicated CP exposition.

Granularity watch, not a blocker: ch-06 is the densest chapter (five distinct kernels: SDPA backends, xFormers, SageAttention, Ring/CP, Paged). Depth floor met: every chapter summary lists >=3 concrete concepts; no chapter is too thin. ch-07 enumerates eight primitives, which is legitimate for a taxonomy chapter rather than an overload.
